worker_approval.human_message: On 24 October 2026, I approve the final freeze and one 350-query live paired comparison under Codex-0306/0307 and proposal R02: maximum 3,150 calls, $300 client budget, no retries or resume, 12-hour worker and 13-hour overall limit. I accept the reviewed rubric, stopping rules and disclosed billing uncertainties, including that the client budget is not a guaranteed invoice ceiling. Use the existing local Databricks credential. No manuscript/statistics changes or promotion.
